label: Ball Action
blurb: The picture is rebuilt out of a tray of little balls, one for each square of a grid, each ball taking its colour from the part of the frame it covers. They are shaded like real spheres with a highlight on the lit side and a dark terminator on the other, they sit in their own shadows, and they can be turned so the colour they carry rolls round the surface. Leave a gap between them and the background shows through, close the gap up and they pack together like a bag of marbles. Rotation can run off the clock so the whole tray rolls as the shot plays.
